non_method_analysis_apis.stationarity.stationarity_report: Assembles the stationarity tests, differencing recommendations and combined verdict.
non_method_analysis_apis.autocorrelation.autocorrelation_report: Assembles correlograms, portmanteau statistics and lag pairs.
non_method_analysis_apis.causality.causality_report: Assembles cross-correlation, Granger and cointegration outputs.
non_method_analysis_apis.changepoints.changepoints_report: Assembles segmentation, stability and regime-fit outputs.
non_method_analysis_apis.distribution.distribution_report: Assembles distributional summaries, density, quantile and complexity outputs.
non_method_analysis_apis.filters.filters_report: Assembles trend-cycle, empirical-mode and wavelet outputs.
non_method_analysis_apis.fractal.fractal_report: Assembles scaling, multifractal and graph-dimension outputs.
non_method_analysis_apis.nonlinear.nonlinear_report: Assembles embedded-state, recurrence, chaos and surrogate diagnostics.
non_method_analysis_apis.seasonality.seasonality_report: Assembles spectral, decomposition and seasonal-subseries outputs.
non_method_analysis_apis.sequence.finite_sequence: Enforces the finite contiguous input contract; it estimates no numerical property.
non_method_analysis_apis.volatility.volatility_report: Assembles conditional-variance, transformation and rolling-dispersion outputs.
